title: Fee said on the call does not match the plan

expect.summary: Operator says about twenty a month; the plan record is $34.00 per month. Fee item is a mismatch, first charge held.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My neighbor uses you. I want to sign up for myself. Walter Briggs.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Welcome, Walter. GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Good. I don't do apps.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Let me get your address for pickups.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: 1180 Orchard Lane, apartment 3.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: And an emergency contact?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My son, Peter. I'll give you his number.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thank you. And what kind of trips will you take most?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Doctor visits mostly. The clinic on Fifth, and the pharmacy. Sometimes church on Sundays.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: We can save those as favorite places so you can just press a number.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: That would help a lot.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: I've saved the clinic, the pharmacy and the church. Now, a few things about the membership.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Go ahead.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: So the Value plan is about twenty a month, billed monthly.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, twenty is fine.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Your membership automatically renews every month unless you cancel.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I understand.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: You can cancel any time with no fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in your account settings.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: All right.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our toll-free number is 1-855-464-6872 and our email is support@gogograndparent.com, for cancelling or any questions.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Got it.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Understood.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Walter, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Visa ending in 8803 for the Value plan today and every month until you cancel?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I authorize it.
